human_basis: Latest explicit Operator decision: (Atom ID, Version) pairs are unique across all Atoms including Drafts; promotion chooses a Version above every same-ID Version. Example Current 7 plus Draft 8 yields successor 9. This decision supersedes the Current exact +1 wording; this preview states only the Core invariant and leaves maximum selection to Workflow owners.
